criteria.requirement: Add immutable HighlightResult(html: str, block: bool=False) and integrate it into actual RendererHTML.fence. A nonempty explicit block result is returned as its complete trusted container with exactly one existing/added terminal newline, even when it starts with div/section rather than pre. Explicit inline HTML is wrapped by the real pre/code renderer including language attrs, without legacy pre-prefix inference. Empty explicit results fall back to escaped source. Preserve old string callbacks/pre heuristic and callback arguments, reject invalid result field/types and propagate callback failures. This is trusted highlighter output, not an HTML sanitizer.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
